svg.text: Buzz — agent prompt anatomy
What buzz-acp injects into an ACP agent session — content blocks, where each one is sourced, and the tool wiring that rides JSON payloads + environment instead of prose.
① SESSION BIRTH — session/new · once per ACP session
system role + tool wiring, JSON-RPC over stdio · pool.rs create_session_and_apply_model()
"cwd": "/…/<agent-workspace>",
"mcpServers": [ { name, command, args, env } ], // tool wiring → ④
"systemPrompt": "…", // system role — expands below ↓
"title": "<Agent> — #<channel>"
systemPrompt = the sections below, joined with blank lines ↓
[Workspace]
Absolute working-directory anchor, so the model doesn't wander $HOME hunting for its workspace.
src: pool.rs workspace_section() · only emitted when a base prompt is present
[Base]
Harness manual: buzz-CLI index table, mention & threading etiquette, workspace layout,
memory + engineering discipline.
src: base_prompt.md compiled into buzz-acp · --base-prompt-file override · --no-base-prompt disables
[System]
The agent's own instructions from the desktop Agents menu (record → persona → global resolve).
src: BUZZ_ACP_SYSTEM_PROMPT at spawn, else owner-published kind:30177 — re-fetched each new session
[Team Instructions]
Present whenever the agent belongs to a team with non-empty instructions — never gated on the
team being addressed. Baked at spawn; edits need an agent restart.
src: team record → BUZZ_ACP_TEAM_INSTRUCTIONS spawn env · spawn_hash.rs effective_team_instructions()
[Agent Memory — core]
Durable identity, rules, and goals — auto-injected every session; the agent edits it via buzz mem.
src: relay kind:30174 engram, fetched + decrypted per new session · --no-memory disables
[Channel Canvas]
Pointer only — revision event id, last-modified, and the fetch command. Canvas content is
never inlined. Skipped for DMs and heartbeat turns.
src: relay kind:40100 latest for #h=<channel> · pool.rs render_canvas_section()
② EVERY TURN — session/prompt · user message
ordered text blocks — one per section, so the desktop observer can trim bodies but keep headers · queue.rs format_prompt()
"sessionId": "sess_…",
"prompt": [
{ "type": "text", "text": "[Context] …" }, // one block per section ↓
… // text-only: attachment bytes never ride the prompt
prompt[] = these blocks, in this order ↓
/command args (optional block 0)
Slash-command pass-through: a lone "@Agent /cmd" mention sends the bare command as the first
block, so ACP connectors detect it as a native command.
src: pool.rs · queue.rs slash_command_for_batch()
[Context]
Scope (channel / thread / dm), channel name + UUID, resolved reply-to anchor, fetch-more hints.
src: queue.rs format_context_hints() — computed from trigger tags + channel metadata
[Thread Context] / [Conversation Context]
Prior messages oldest→newest — thread replies and DMs only; a plain top-level mention gets
none (just a hint to fetch). Default 12 messages, max 100.
src: per-turn relay fetch (root + #e replies, or DM history) · BUZZ_ACP_CONTEXT_MESSAGE_LIMIT
[Buzz event: @mention] / [Buzz events — N events]
The trigger(s), batched ≤50: event id, kind, sender (name via kind:0 profile lookup), time,
content, full Tags JSON + parsed root / parent / mentions. Attachments ride here as NIP-92
imeta tags — URLs only, never bytes; the agent fetches via buzz media get or view_image.
src: subscribed relay events · queue.rs format_event_block() · prompt_tag from the matched rule
[What you were working on] / [New message — arrived while you were working]
Merge framing when events land mid-turn or after a cancel: prior work first, then the fresh
arrivals, plus a closing instruction.
src: queue.rs MergeFraming — cancel / steer requeue path
Legacy agents (protocol_version < 2)
No system role — the entire ① stack repeats as user-message sections here, every turn.
③ SPECIAL TURNS — separate prompts through the same pipe
[Initial message] — first turn of a fresh session
Operator-configured first prompt — sent alone right after session/new, before any event turn.
src: BUZZ_ACP_INITIAL_MESSAGE
[System: Heartbeat]
Timed wake-up: UTC timestamp + fixed checklist (buzz feed get needs_action / mentions → act).
Carries no context, memory, or canvas sections.
src: lib.rs default_heartbeat_prompt() · --heartbeat-prompt / --heartbeat-prompt-file override
④ TOOLING — delivered as wiring + environment, not prose
mcpServers → buzz-dev-mcp (stdio)
shell · read_file · str_replace · view_image · todo
+ hidden _Stop / _PostCompact hooks (filtered from
the model's tool list). buzz-agent + codex only —
Claude Code & Goose bring their own native tools.
src: lib.rs build_mcp_servers() → session/new JSON
Ambient env + PATH
buzz CLI first on PATH — ~/.local/bin symlink, or the
dev-mcp shim dir (also rg, tree, git-credential-nostr,
git-sign-nostr). Creds inherited from the harness:
BUZZ_RELAY_URL · BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY · BUZZ_AUTH_TAG.
src: runtime/path.rs · nest.rs · dev-mcp shim.rs
CLI disclosure ladder (progressive)
① base-prompt table: 13 of 24 groups, key commands
② buzz --help / buzz <group> --help on demand
③ skills/buzz-cli/SKILL.md — output contracts, exit
codes, gotchas: only what --help can't say.
src: base_prompt.md · nest_skill.md → skill-dir symlinks
✕ NEVER IN THE PROMPT
canvas content (pointer only) · channel history on plain top-level mentions · attachment bytes (URLs pass through) · the full CLI reference · "projects" — no such concept in the pipeline
persona pack instructions.md (resolved but never consumed) · setup-mode requirement nudges — published to the channel as messages, never prompted into an agent
buzz-acp session lifecycle — sources: pool.rs · queue.rs · base_prompt.md · definition_fetch.rs · engram_fetch.rs · desktop managed_agents (spawn_hash.rs, runtime.rs, nest.rs) · 2026-07
